about.title: About Lunara Sarees
about.art1: Rooted in Kandy, Sri Lanka, Lunara Sarees celebrates the timeless elegance of the Kandyan saree and the beauty of the traditional Osariya drape.
about.art2: We bring together thoughtfully selected sarees that honour Sri Lankan heritage while embracing the individuality of the modern woman. From everyday elegance to life's most meaningful occasions, each piece is chosen to make you feel confident, graceful and beautifully yourself.
about.collections1: Discover a considered selection of Kandyan sarees in cotton, handloom, batik and hand-painted fabrics.
about.collections2: Every collection brings together distinctive colours, thoughtful details and beautiful craftsmanship. Each saree is offered as a complete set, including the saree and its matching jacket material, so you have everything you need to create a coordinated look.
about.yours1: At Lunara, we believe your outfit should reflect your own style.
about.yours2: Our sarees are supplied with unstitched jacket material, giving you the freedom to choose your preferred design, fit and tailoring style.
about.yours3: Jacket stitching and measurements are not provided. We leave that creative freedom in your hands, so your finished outfit can be tailored to your personal preference.
about.shopping1: We believe shopping for a saree should be simple, convenient and reassuring.

point.ordering: Shop as a guest without creating an account.
point.delivery: We deliver across all 25 districts of Sri Lanka.
point.dispatch: Orders are dispatched within one working day after confirmation.
point.payments: Choose between Cash on Delivery and bank transfer.
point.care: Eligible returns and exchanges are accepted within 7 days of delivery, provided the saree is unworn and the jacket material remains uncut.

about.shopping2: Please refer to our <shipping>Shipping & Delivery Policy</shipping> and <returns>Returns & Refund Policy</returns> for complete details.
about.honest1: We believe that knowing what you are buying is just as important as loving what you see.
about.honest2: Some of our fashion images feature AI-generated model photography, created to illustrate how a saree may look when worn. These images are visual representations and may not perfectly reflect the actual product's colour, fabric texture or finer details.
about.honest3: We encourage you to review the product descriptions and available product details before placing an order. If you have questions about a particular saree, its colour or design, please contact us. We will be happy to help.
about.honest4: For more information, please read our <colour>Product Colour & Image Disclaimer</colour>.
about.experience1: A saree is more than an outfit. It is an expression of culture, individuality and personal elegance.
about.experience2: At Lunara Sarees, we invite you to discover pieces that celebrate tradition, complement your style and become part of your most cherished moments.
about.closing: Lunara Sarees — Elegance in Every Thread.
